sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NOT NULL AND T1.month=0,1,0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL AND T1.month=0,1,0)) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(T1.name), IIF(SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NOT NULL AND T1.month=0,1,0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL AND T1.month=0,1,0))>0,'YES','NO') AS isHigh FROM longest_absense_from_school T1 LEFT JOIN disabled T2 ON T2.name=T1.name
SELECT CAST(COUNT(T4.name) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(T2.name) FROM enlist T1 INNER JOIN enrolled T2 ON T1.name=T2.name LEFT JOIN male T4 ON T1.name=T4.name WHERE T2.school='ucla' AND T1.organ='air_force'

SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.school = 'uci' AND T4.name IS NULL, 1, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.name) FROM enrolled AS T1 INNER JOIN person AS T2 ON T1.name = T2.name INNER JOIN disabled AS T3 ON T2.name = T3.name LEFT JOIN male AS T4 ON T2.name = T4.name
